title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Berry Cherry Limeade
description: Top up your Vaporesso Dojo Blast kit with the Berry Cherry Limeade Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Engineered with the freshness-locking INSTA-JUICED design, the 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid remains securely isolated inside the 10ml container during transit, ensuring your coil is perfectly pristine upon assembly. Berry Cherry Limeade is a complex and refreshing profile that layers sweet mixed Berries and bold Cherry over a zesty Limeade base. The result is a vibrant, well-balanced vape that combines rich, jammy fruit notes with a sharp, citrus-forward finish. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
